items.title: Tenant isolation
items.body: Each organization's data is separated at database level with row-level access rules.

items.title: Role-based access
items.body: Owners, managers and cashiers only see what their role allows.

items.title: Audit trails
items.body: Key actions are logged with user, time and change.

items.title: Encryption in transit
items.body: All traffic to this website and the platform uses HTTPS.

items.body: Where possible, data is stored in your region. See the sub-processor list for locations.

items.title: Responsible disclosure
items.body: If you believe you have found a vulnerability, email {email}. Please do not access other users' data.
